projectDescription: EVerest is an open-source, modular firmware framework for EV charging stations, providing a full software stack with support for AC/DC charging, OCPP 1.6/2.0.1/2.1, ISO 15118, energy management, and hardware drivers for charge controllers, powermeters, and more.
keyFeatures: Modular microservice-like architecture with MQTT-based inter-module communication
Full OCPP support: OCPP 1.6, 2.0.1, and 2.1 via a single combined module
ISO 15118-2, -3, -20 (Plug & Charge, V2G) and IEC 61851 / DIN SPEC 70121 support
AC and DC charging with multi-EVSE configurations
Ready-to-use hardware drivers for BSPs, powermeters, isolation monitors, RFID/NFC readers, DC power supplies
Integrated energy management and local energy APIs
Stable external APIs over MQTT (EVerestAPI) and JSON-RPC (RpcApi)
Configuration and Lifecycle management APIs for remote runtime management
Yocto support for embedded Linux images with OTA update capability
Developer tooling: ev-cli code generation, devcontainer, simulation-in-the-loop (SIL) configs
Security best practices: TPM, OpenSSF, ISO/IEC 5230 license compliance
Modules can be written in C++, Python, JavaScript, or Rust
publicApiSurface: Configuration API (MQTT) — list/get/set/create/delete configuration slots at runtime
Lifecycle API (MQTT) — start/stop/restart module instances at runtime
EVerestAPI (MQTT / AsyncAPI 3.0) — evse_manager_consumer_API, auth_consumer_API, powermeter_API, ocpp_consumer_API, power_supply_DC_API, etc.
RpcApi (JSON-RPC over WebSocket) — charging session data and parameter control
ev-cli module / interface / types / helpers subcommands
Module interface: Commands (CMDs) and Variables (VARs) via MQTT
EvseManager module — evse_manager interface, IEC 61851 state machine, energy transfer modes
OCPPmulti module — Mode: Only1.6 / Only2 / Auto configuration
Auth module — token provider / validator interfaces
SLAC module — EV / EVSE SLAC (ISO 15118-3) interface
EvseV2G / IsoMux / Evse15118D20 modules — ISO 15118-2/20 stack
